notes: «أو حدثني الحكم» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route
«قال سألت ابن عباس» : the asker (Sa'id) is already a link; Ibn Abbas, the one asked and answering, is the last link (rules 5 and 6)
«فذكرت هذا لمجاهد فقال إلا من ندم» is a remark by Mujahid with no transmitter of its own, left out
